name: Shannon L. McColley
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Shannon L. McColley as an author of “The GeoDataHub: A digital archive of New Zealand government mapping”.
